title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-15
source: Sony Stereo ECM -->SONY TCD126 Location: TBD

ai_review.summary: A rough‑sounding recording that nonetheless delivers one of the best Dead-era setlists.
ai_review.review: The reviewer notes the audio is a little rough, suggesting a less than pristine source, but praises the show as featuring the band's peak era and an outstanding setlist. Overall the performance shines despite modest recording quality.

ai_rating.rationale: The single 4‑star review is enthusiastic about the music (high show value) while flagging only minor sound issues, leading to a strong combined rating with moderate confidence due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the sound as "a little rough," indicating some clarity or balance issues but no severe dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Highly regarded setlist, described as one of the best the band ever played.
